Note: printed in scientific notation (e.g. 441.90 x 10^6), converted to numeric by the cleaning script

Definition: neuronal density in the cerebral cortical grey matter, in neurons per mg (or neurons per mm3 where taken from other authors)

Definition: total surface area of the cerebral cortex, in mm2

Note: printed asterisk marks rows where the ratio includes white matter; asterisks stripped in cleaning

Definition: thickness of the cortical grey matter in mm, computed by the author as cortical volume divided by cortical surface area (VCX/ACX)

Definition: mass of the cortical grey matter in grams, or its volume in cm3 where taken from other authors
